subtitle: Quran revision, on schedule
promotionalText: Revise your hifz on a schedule that fits your life. Swipe through real mushaf pages, log every session, and see which pages are slipping before they're gone.
description:
Revisely is a Quran revision tracker built around a schedule that fits your hifz.

Pick how much you want to cover each day, and Revisely rotates through everything you've memorized on a repeating cycle. As you memorize more, the cycle grows with you. Miss a day and the schedule keeps moving instead of piling up, or step back a day when you need to catch up.

Inside:

• Three ways to schedule: pages per day (1–60), juz per day (1–5), or a custom plan you build day by day, starting from any point
• Full-page mushaf revision: swipe through the actual pages of the Qur'an, check each one off, and optionally rate its strength from 1 to 5. A timer shows how long the session took
• Smart Tracking (optional): an Insights tab that ranks your memorized pages by how weak you've rated them and how often they've been skipped, so you know where to focus. Your daily assignment stays on schedule; this shows you what's slipping
• Fajr-aligned days: start your revision day at dawn instead of midnight, so a late-night session counts for the right day. Uses your location to calculate fajr
• Memorization manager: browse the Qur'an by surah, juz or hizb, and mark pages as you memorize them
• Daily log: a simple journal of what you memorized and revised each day, with your own notes
• Read tab and reading timer: a separate Qur'an reader for reading outside of revision, with timed reading sessions and your reading history
• Streaks, full session history with editing, and daily reminders

How it works:

1. Mark what you've already memorized
2. Choose how much to revise each day, and whether your day starts at fajr or midnight
3. Open the app each day, tap Start revision, and swipe through your pages

Sign in with Apple, Google or email, and your progress syncs across your devices. You can delete your account and all of its data at any time from Settings.

Built for people who want to keep the Qur'an they've memorized. Made to be used every day.
reviewNotes:
Revisely is a Quran revision tracker. It is free, with no in-app purchases.

The demo account is pre-populated so you land on a full dashboard: about 166 pages memorized (Al-Fatiha and the last six juz), some of Al-Baqarah in progress, and seven days of completed revision sessions ending yesterday, with Smart Tracking turned on.

New in 1.0.2:
- A new design across the whole app, in light or dark. Settings > Appearance > Accent picks the accent colour.
- The Clear Quran® translation by Dr. Mustafa Khattab, alongside Saheeh International (the default). Press and hold a verse, tap Translation, then ⋯ > Select translation > "The Clear Quran® — Dr. Mustafa Khattab". Its text comes from the publisher's API (Al-Furqaan Foundation) under their developer agreement, shown exactly as given, with the credit and a link to theclearquran.org under the verse.
- Recording backup: recordings are backed up to the user's own account (see Permissions).
- Settings > Support > Report a problem sends a short report (what went wrong, optionally a screenshot) with technical details to our error monitoring service. Contact support writes to support@revisely.app.

Once signed in:
- Home shows today's revision. Tap "Start revision" to open a session. The page fills the screen; tap it for the controls. Swiping past a page marks it revised (or tap the check at the top); ⋯ > Rate page strength rates it 1 to 5. Submit appears once every page is done.
- The bottom bar has three icon tabs: Home, Read (a separate Qur'an reader) and Insights (pages ranked by weakness and skips).
- On Home, the ⋯ on the Today post opens Edit schedule and Memorized pages. The two icons at the top right open Activity (a calendar of sessions, recordings and the daily log) and Settings.
- In a session or the Read tab, the bar at the bottom holds Play, the reciter, the microphone and the timer. The microphone records the user reciting: tap the time to pause or resume and the square to stop; View then opens the recording in Activity, where it can be played or deleted.
- Press and hold a verse for Play and Translation.
- Yesterday's unfinished pages carry over into today. Settings > Revision > Keep daily amount (on by default) moves today's revision on by them; turned off, they are added on top.

Permissions:
- Microphone is requested only when the user taps record. Recordings are saved on the device and backed up to the user's own account (on by default, Wi-Fi only unless mobile data is allowed; Settings > Activity > Back up recordings turns it off). Only that account can read the backup. Deleting a recording deletes its backup too.
- Location is requested only if the user turns on Settings > Day boundary > Start day at fajr, to calculate local fajr time. It is not requested otherwise.
- Notifications are used for the daily revision reminder (time set in Settings) and to signal the end of a timed session.

Account deletion: Settings > Delete account (at the bottom) permanently deletes the account and all of its data, including backed-up recordings (guideline 5.1.1(v)).

Qur'an page images are renderings of the Madani Mushaf made with the King Fahd Glorious Qur'an Printing Complex fonts (open-source quran.com-images project), served from our own storage.
